title: Vegan Tofu Patties in Spicy Tomato Sauce
subtitle: chraime-style
description: Herby tofu patties baked and simmered in a spicy capsicum and tomato sauce flavoured with paprika and cumin, in the style of chraime.

steps.text: Make the patties: blend the tofu with the parsley, half the coriander, dill, 3 cloves of garlic, flour and 3 tbsp olive oil in a food processor. Line a tray with baking paper, grease it and form the mixture into patties on the tray.
Brush the tops of the patties with olive oil and bake in an oven preheated to 180°C for 20-25 minutes. Cool.
Make the sauce: cut the capsicums into strips, dice the tomatoes and finely chop the remaining 6 cloves of garlic. Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a wide frying pan, add the garlic and fry for 1 minute.
Add the capsicum and tomatoes, stir and cook for 4-5 minutes. Add the paprika, cumin, salt and pepper and stir.
Add the water, stir and cover the pan. Cook over medium heat for 20 minutes until the capsicum and tomatoes break down (add more water if needed). Turn off the heat.
Add the patties to the sauce and sprinkle with the remaining chopped coriander.
